capabilities: Animate text with tag-based effects (shiver, shake, rage, shock, wave)
Colorize words using a configurable palette with a special rainbow effect
Insert washi-tape divider code blocks via command palette
Extend tapes with custom .jm-washi--<id> CSS rules in vault snippets
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; custom tape CSS should live in vault snippets, not the plugin's styles.css, or updates will delete it.
intentEvidence: adds analog-journal inspired expressiveness into your notes with syntax that doesn't get in the way of reading
motivation: The README states 'Because digital journaling should be more playful', aiming to bring analog-journal expressiveness to digital notes.
problem: Digital notes are plain and lack the playful, expressive decoration of analog paper journals.
summary: Styling plugin that adds animated text, color, sparkles, and washi-tape dividers to notes via minimal markup for expressive journaling.
